sayLines.line: 📨 Word came: Boris Kowalski wants to join Haven. "My village is gone. Yours isn't. That's the whole of it." — they haven't set foot here. The village will judge.
📨 Word came: Ella Johnson wants to join Haven. "My village is gone. Yours isn't. That's the whole of it." — they haven't set foot here. The village will judge.
Investigate and the morning is gone — tracking them costs a full day-part. Bar the door and you learn nothing. Your call.
📓 Codex: The old argument between Mingyu and Esteban ended — one of them is gone.
🤒 Tashi is on the mend — the fever broke.

💛 You hold Oath Ring. You made the promise at seventeen, stupid and certain, the way seventeen is. The person is gone. The promise isn't. It never will be. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they are with you. The feast was the weapon. (The next feast grants FEASTED until tomorrow's dawn: strikes & abilities uplifted, devotion ×1.5 — richer feasts hit harder.)

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and with it the joy: food gives you no morale, feasts give you no comfort, and your fire never burns hotter than this. A cold spot at every table.
